name: Lady Penelope Sterling
look: an elegant, wealthy elderly lady with a tall silver-grey hair bun, cat-eye glasses on a chain and a proud raised chin; a long purple dress, a white feather boa, a big pearl necklace and a small purple handbag
personality: Snobbish but sharp-tongued and funny; owner of most of the things that go missing.
catchphrase: Do you know who I AM?
